there is a statistically significant relationship between public education expenditure and economic growth.
there is a significant positive correlation between public spending on education and GDP in the European Union and the BRICS countries.

a comparative analysis of the impact of public education expenditure on economic growth of European Union and the BRICS countries.
the impact of public expenditure on education on economic growth of the EU and BRICS countries.
the question whether the public expenditure for education has a significant effect on the economic growth of European Union and Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa.
